description: Source code implementing routing and socket communication for RT messaging system, including listener binding, client handling, message dispatch, and direct routing.

methods.name: rtRouteBase_CloseListener
methods.description: Closes a listener socket, shutting down and closing the connection.

methods.name: rtRouteBase_BindListener
methods.description: Creates and binds a socket listener to a specified address, with options for no delay and retry behavior.

methods.name: _rtdirect_send_reply_to_client
methods.description: Sends a reply message to a connected client with encoded header and payload.

methods.name: _rtdirect_prepare_reply_from_request
methods.description: Prepares a reply message header based on a request header.

methods.name: _rtdirect_OnMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, including subscription requests and default message processing, invoking registered callbacks.

methods.name: _rtdirect_pushFd
methods.description: Adds a file descriptor to an fd_set for select, updating maxFd.

methods.name: _rtdirect_dispatch_message_from_client
methods.description: Dispatches a received message from a client to the appropriate route handler.

methods.name: rtConnectedClient_Init
methods.description: Initializes a connected client structure with socket and endpoint info.

methods.name: rtConnectedClient_Reset
methods.description: Resets client read state to prepare for next message.

methods.name: rtConnectedClient_Read
methods.description: Reads data from client socket, processes message headers and payload, and dispatches messages.

methods.name: rtRouteDirect_RegisterNewClient
methods.description: Registers a new client connection upon accept, initializing client structure.

methods.name: rtRouteDirect_AcceptClientConnection
methods.description: Accepts incoming client connection on listener socket and registers new client.

methods.name: rtRouteDirect_SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a client with appropriate header encoding.

methods.name: rtRouteDirect_StartInstance
methods.description: Starts the direct routing instance, binding socket, handling incoming connections, and message dispatch loop.
